caption:
is a pea of retinol the right amount?

"Pea-sized" is a rule of thumb, not a universal unit.

Most retinoid labels don't mention a pea at all. They say "a thin layer". One prescription gel (adapalene with benzoyl peroxide) says to use a pea-sized amount for each area of the face — forehead, chin and each cheek. That's four.

And more doesn't work faster. One tretinoin label says using more than directed won't give faster or better results, and may cause marked redness, peeling or discomfort.

Check yours tonight: read the label on your retinol or retinoid. Thin layer, one pea, or one per area?

Skin Test #12/30 from a doctor in Seoul. Follow for #13: has your vitamin C serum gone off?

General education only. Follow your own product's directions or your prescriber's.
